description: This is a React component sourced from a TSX file implementing a Dashboard view for a career navigation app, including state management, data fetching via API calls, and rendering UI elements.

methods.name: deriveTraffic
methods.description: Determines traffic light status based on profile level and target.

methods.name: normalizeBreakdown
methods.description: Converts raw data rows into structured GapRow objects.

methods.name: loadAll
methods.description: Fetches user profile, evidence, KPIs, and gap analysis data asynchronously.

methods.name: onRefreshKpis
methods.description: Handles manual refresh of KPIs and gap analysis data.

methods.name: onExportPdf
methods.description: Exports user profile data as a PDF document.

methods.name: chip
methods.description: Generates a styled UI chip component.

methods.name: trafficDot
methods.description: Returns a colored dot representing traffic status.
